name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source email platform for transactional emails, marketing campaigns and automated workflows, sending through AWS SES.

alerts.message: Plunk sends every email through AWS SES. Replace AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SES_REGION and SES_CONFIGURATION_SET with your own SES credentials and configuration set before sending, and subscribe the SNS topic to https://api.<your-domain>/webhooks/sns for bounce and open tracking.
The API is served on the api. subdomain of the app domain, so that hostname must resolve to this server too. Sign-ups are open: create your account, then set DISABLE_SIGNUPS to true and redeploy.
